notes.title: Important News
notes.content:
Eat Create Sleep is no longer publishing with Curve Games, we have both mutually agreed to not continue working together on Among Ripples: Shallow Waters.

We want to explain to you what this means for the future of our company and the game (but don't worry, there's still good news). The game is still being developed and will be released! It will just take a bit more work and time to get to that point.

What we've been working on as of March

First off, here's a small video on the current state of Among Ripples: Shallow Waters. We've been adding a lot of cool new features and gameplay improvements!

[previewyoutube=7i_8GSLXWjU;full][/previewyoutube]

Possible Questions, And Answers

Q: Are we still releasing the game?
A: Yes!
Discussions and plans are in the works, and we are confident we will be working with a new publisher in the fall. Some of our team will continue working on Among Ripples: Shallow Waters, while the rest will be taking part in work for hire projects until this point so we can keep things running smoothly.

Q: Will this affect the release date?
A: Yes, just a little bit
Our previous release timeframe we have advertised has been within 2023, but we are now looking at within 2024. We will keep you posted on any exact dates!

Q: Will your awesome social media still be active?
A: Partly, it will be a bit quiet for a few months.
Due to this situation, our team has been subject to some cuts. As such, your community developer being one of them (hi! It's me, the one writing this), will be handing over the work to Martin and Johannes to manage temporarily, thus why it may be a little quieter for a short period. 

You can still follow us and reach out if you have any questions - we will be updating you all as things progress! 


A message from the community developer:
With that being said, I'd just like to add that I've had a wonderful time at Eat Create Sleep over the past 8 months, and have had the best coworkers ever. I'm really sad to be leaving my position at this time, but I'm looking forward to either returning in the future or if not, finding my next opportunity in the field of games. :)
-Jasper Falk

Thanks for supporting us ✨

notes.title: Collab With Publisher - ECS + Curve Games
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Martin from Eat Create Sleep here. In this newsletter I'm going to talk more about the biz, it means we're working with a publisher, and that the game is going to be able to reach its full potential, read more below.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/8e89492eb68184f46220d30af11e96922a9242d6.png



Working With Our Publisher
We've been working with Curve Games for a few months now and they are comprised of seasoned developers and marketeers who've been working on the who's who (or "who's what"?) in strategy, simulation, and tycoony games.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/2f50434029c546c4fb26f04ab175a8892eb36829.png


We're very confident that they can make Among Ripples: Shallow Waters a good game with resources way beyond if we'd self-publish it. We can't say much about when and how, but 2023 is the year we want to release, and it's coming to Steam on PC, at least. Maybe more, no promises!




Preview of Game
If you want to see a preview of how the game looks now, let the gifs commence!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/6c4062474d01b283bb51a04b36f2950aa96b9d87.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/33b0e9dad4165fb4b9cd2567240726f34aee1da9.gif

notes.title: Prototype Demo + Kickstarter in Spring 2021
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35154145/527c8230624d86728105c25da7d88ea9338305d8.png
Hello friends!


Here’s a new update from us. The "Covid crater" coined previously is sadly still taking up space, but it won’t stop us from launching our new prototype demo, cinematic trailer and Kickstarter campaign in Spring 2021!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/02a11e9045cc33590e6dbbc7076125101ead6a8a.png
What’s been happening? 

We’re continuing to survive doing work for hire and supporting other game projects. We helped Might and Delight with programming for Book of Travels, a TMO (Tiny Online Multiplayer) that PC Gamer wrote: “It could change the way we think about MMOs..”

We're still working remotely. We’ve taken on art interns and a new part time community manager. The team is continuing to work on the release for you! It may be a bit slower than we imagined but it’s happening. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/ff26ee4b2cf2485ee90f896d4beec5d90a4785f2.png
Cinematic Sneak Peeks 

Do you remember the storyboard video prototype we shared in October this year? 

We’re breathing life into these cinematic environments and beautiful sweeping shots. Our trailer will not only feature in our new prototype demo, but on socials and in our kickstarter.

We hope you enjoy the mockups (and rabbits) as much as we do!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35154145/6ef4b14fc5aab24feb421284d43642790c259746.png
The Year 2040 - A Peaceful Future?

Alongside our cool looking VTOL aircraft we have come up with something we call an "EMP Torus" which is meant to be a peaceful deterrent in this world. Wars and conflicts exist in this future too, but we might just have found a way to deal with them more smartly, more peacefully. Above you can see our idea about "anti-weapon weapons", or a super huge EMP device run on renewable energy.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35154145/1756a40cc96f41d59e6194641991a4a1ee88c70a.png
We are Crabpunk 

Stories are a bit like roads… Some go to dark places, happy places, others wind through heaven and hell. Among Ripples is one of those stories. Cyberpunk is a dystopian genre showing us roads we as societies shouldn’t take. Utopia or “Hopepunk” depicts the paths we need to take to achieve happiness on Earth. A friend once said it’s like a society's collective dreams and nightmares. And what happens between those states are the waking moments when we’re conscious.

We may be pessimistic sometimes, the struggles we face to obtain sustainable living feels almost impossible…. Do we have a future? That’s what we’re imagining in Among Ripples: Shallow Waters. Utopia feels alien and a dystopia too close to home. So we’re calling it Crabpunk; a future far from perfect, but one I can imagine us working towards.

As we said before, publishers have been interested but a few people in the game industry are on the fence. Some people think environment and ecology is too niche. But we know it’s not, and with your support, we're going to make it! Let's crab it!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35154145/8e08b716621547b242404344dde58fdc750386d4.png
Stay safe & stay in touch!


Our socials are hibernating at the moment, but we monitor them daily. You can communicate with us via twitter and instagram. If you want more pictures of our pets, and exclusive info on when the prototype and kickstarter launch sign up to our newsletter.

Newsletter: http://eepurl.com/gJDx0T
Twitter: twitter.com/EatCreateSleep
Instagram: instagram.com/eatcreatesleep

See you in 2021!

Eat Create Sleep

notes.title: Kickstarter - Early 2021
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been awhile, I hope you're safe. We're still working and things are finally settling after the "Covid crater" as a colleague put it. It's been a hectic few months since March, 2020. But now we're back to inform that we will launch a new Kickstarter campaign in early 2021! Let's start with showing our work in progress intro to celebrate (soon you can see it in glorious three dimensions).


[previewyoutube=MDR2REC4k-4;full][/previewyoutube]



What's Been Happening?
In short we've spent these months trying to survive, doing work for hire, applying for loans, grants and investments. We also spent two months pitching to a major publisher and almost got signed with a huge budget, but fell through. It's also been interesting to transition to a complete remote team, from being in an office for 5+ years. We're going to work remotely as long as the pandemic continues.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/ddc1d781cc5994355e15d3a043280588c387394d.jpg


We've found more work for hire until the end of the year and our investors have given us some more money to keep going. We're in a position where half of the team can work full on with the prototype and prepare for the new release.



Improved Prototype
Since March, 2020 we've improved the feedback and are upgrading the visuals, the economy system and improved the animal AI and mechanics. It's still a proof of concept, but we're trying to show how we can iterate with feedback. There's still no insects though, sorry. ;) Check out the paintover below with our new "Eco Ship", a VTOL aircraft (vertical take-off and landing), it will complement our awesome eco van.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/6b87344d40b8208d6f7a84b7ea2c4b8e11daadd3.jpg


A New Kickstarter
We're doing a new campaign in the beginning of next year, early 2021. There are publishers who are slightly interested, but a lot of people in the game industry are on the fence, they want us to show numbers, some feel that games about the environment and ecology is too niche. If you ask me I think it's something that anyone on Earth can relate to in some way, but I digress. We're going to show everyone that Among Ripples: Shallow Waters is a game people want, and with you, our early fans we're going to make it!


Let's Stay in Touch
We've updated our social media presence, and right now we communicate through Twitter, Instagram and our newsletter mainly. If you want to stay up to date or check out cute pictures of our pets, that's where to be.

     Newsletter: http://eepurl.com/gJDx0T
     Twitter: https://twitter.com/EatCreateSleep
     Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/eatcreatesleep/




____________________________


See you soon!
//Martin & Eat Create Sleep

notes.title: Ask the Devs - They Will Ask Back (?!)
notes.content:
Hello old and new fans!



We're part of Steam Game Festival and to celebrate that we're hosting a "you ask us, we ask you" session. 



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154145/c2e7fc2e5c3f359feed6586d1c45773f55ec4389.gif




You Ask Us
The rules are simple, you ask us questions about the game, our game studio or general development questions and we will answer. We will host these question sessions online until the 22th June, 2020. You can ask us questions on these platforms:



Here on Steam (just reply to the thread)
Twitter Post
Kickstarter Post
Facebook Post
Discord (in the #among-ripples channel)




We will answer these questions during the coming days on these platforms, but please be patient during the weekend, we need our beauty sleep. We will compile all the answers into a FAQ which we will post on our newsletter (sign up today!) next week. You need to sign up to get the full demo experience anyway so there's a nice bonus for you. ;)




We Ask You
In the same newsletter where we compile all answers from all platforms we're going to send you a few questions too, a questionnaire. We want to know what you think about some decisions and features. If you don't ask you'll never know, as they say. What you ask us first might change the nature of the questionnaire so your actions have consequences, they create ripples, as it were.


So please ask us questions until the 22th June and after that we'll send you newsletter folk a compiled list. We will be answering questions live-ish on each platform but only compile in the newsletter (hey, we got to collect eyeballs too you know).



Stay safe!
